title: Rainy Day Days Out: Indoor Ideas for Kids of All Ages
description: Rainy day days out for families: aquariums, museums, indoor play, swimming, bowling, cinemas and studio tours, without overspending.
h1: Rainy day days out: indoor ideas the kids will love
intro: When the heavens open, you don’t have to cancel the fun. Here are the best indoor days out for wet weather, from free museums to aquariums.

image.alt: A little girl holding an umbrella in the rain

keywords: things to do when it rains
cardText: Aquariums, museums, swimming and indoor play for wet-weather days.

blocks.title: Scout’s rainy-day rescue
blocks.text: Indoor attractions get busiest on wet weekends. Book a timed slot if you can, or go early, before everyone else checks the forecast.
points: Free museums are the best-value indoor option
Aquariums are short visits: pair with lunch out
Puddle-jumping in wellies is free fun too!

sections.html:
• National museums: see our free London museums and free days out guides.
  • Libraries: free story times and holiday crafts.
  • Indoor markets and shopping centres with play areas.

• Aquariums like SEA LIFE: see zoos and aquariums.
  • Studio tours like the Harry Potter Studio Tour.
  • Swimming pools with flumes and wave machines.
  • Soft play, trampoline parks, bowling and climbing walls.
  • Cinema: many chains run cheaper kids’ morning screenings in the holidays.
Waterproofs plus wellies equals puddle-jumping, a bug hunt and an empty playground. A short rainy walk followed by hot chocolate is a classic for a reason.

faqs.q: What can you do with kids on a rainy day for free?
faqs.a: Visit a free national museum, go to library story time, explore an indoor market or put on waterproofs for a puddle walk.
